_comment: Pre-computed Vision-Agent extraction results for dataset/media/images/*.png. Keyed by image_id. Each entry gives the financial facts a vision-capable model would extract for the event linked via images.csv related_event_id. Used as a zero-cost cache so the pipeline is fully runnable without any LLM API key. If VISION_MODEL/LLM_API_KEY are configured and an image_id is missing from this cache, the live vision agent (src/evidence.py) is called instead and the result is appended here.
